role.en: Conductor. Triages every watched channel, decides clusters, reviews the Thread Watcher's verdicts on possibly-resolved threads, writes the digest headline, spawns investigators, and answers the owner. Woken by the poller when something moved.
role.zh: 指挥者。给所有被关注频道的消息分诊，决定聚簇，复核线程观察员对“可能已解决”线程的结论，写摘要标题，派出调查员，并回答所有者。有变化时由轮询器唤醒。

role.en: Read-only leaf. Searches GitHub for issues and pull requests matching a cluster and records the links on the items. Never spawns, never writes to GitHub or Slack.
role.zh: 只读的叶子成员。在 GitHub 上搜索与一簇消息匹配的 issue 和 PR，把链接记到条目上。从不派生，从不写 GitHub 或 Slack。

role.en: Read-only leaf, dispatched for the lead after a poll flags possibly-resolved threads: one run per poll judges the whole batch. Judges only whether each thread is resolved. No shell, never spawns.
role.zh: 只读的叶子成员，轮询标出“可能已解决”的线程后替组长派出：每次轮询一次，判断整批。只判断每个线程是否真的已解决。没有 shell，从不派生。

role.en: Gateway code, no model. Runs by itself every poll interval: reads new messages and thread replies with the five Slack read tools, flags likely resolutions, detects an expired login, delivers the digest, and wakes the lead when something moved.
role.zh: 网关里的代码，不用模型。按轮询间隔自己运行：用五个 Slack 只读工具读取新消息和线程回复，标记可能的解决，发现登录过期，投递摘要，有变化时唤醒组长。
